男主：<Picture 1>年轻男性，蓝白细条纹衬衫 + 白 T 恤 + 银项链，短发，现代日常穿搭
女主：<Picture 2>年轻女性，黑色亮面漆皮挂脖紧身衣 + 长手套，凌乱黑发，未来感造型
场景：<Picture 3>科幻医疗舱，白色医疗床、机械臂、青色全息显示屏、冷白顶光



[0‑4s] <Picture 1>Sci‑fi futuristic medical bay, cool white overhead lighting, cyan holographic vital‑sign monitors on walls, robotic medical manipulator arm hovering. Young Asian man lies unconscious on white medical hospital bed, eyes closed, wearing blue‑white thin‑striped shirt and silver necklace, chest rising and falling gently.<Picture 2> Young Asian woman in glossy black latex tight‑fit outfit kneels beside bed, firmly holding the man’s hands, eyes reddened, holding back tears. Low‑frequency hum of equipment, beeping sounds from cardiac monitor, medium close‑up, cinematic photorealism, high detail, 8k, photographic quality.

[4‑8.5s] <Picture 1>The man’s eyelashes flutter as he slowly opens his eyes, vision blurry then gradually focuses. Upon seeing the man regain consciousness,<Picture 2> the woman bursts into joyful tears, trembling as she reaches out and gently caresses his cheek. Heart‑rate monitor beeps accelerate. Medium two‑shot, facial close‑up, realistic tear highlights, delicate skin texture. Woman’s dialogue (choking, tearful tone):老公你醒啦！

[8.5‑15s] <Picture 1>The man props himself up with his elbow and sits up abruptly. He glances around the unfamiliar sci‑fi medical bay then looks toward <Picture 2>the woman in black beside him, showing utter shock and confusion, instinctively shrinking backward. <Picture 2>The woman’s smile freezes, tears still on her cheeks. Over‑the‑shoulder shot cuts to medium two‑shot of the tense stand‑off. <Picture 1>Man’s dialogue (incredulous, confused tone):我穿越了吗？我什么时候结过婚？Holographic background screens flicker with streaming data, scene ends with deep suspenseful ambient sound.
